categories.main_business_segments: Beijing Tiantan Biological Products Corporation Limited primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of blood products. Its main product categories include human albumin, human immunoglobulin (including intravenous and subcutaneous forms), tetanus immunoglobulin, hepatitis B immunoglobulin, recombinant coagulation factors, and other blood-derived products. The company operates multiple subsidiaries specializing in blood product manufacturing and plasma collection.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced biological and biochemical separation technologies such as low-temperature ethanol protein separation and chromatographic purification. It employs virus inactivation and removal processes to ensure product safety. Additionally, it develops recombinant products using gene recombination technology, including recombinant coagulation factors produced in Chinese hamster ovary cells. The production process includes plasma collection, component separation, purification, virus inactivation, formulation, sterilization, and lyophilization.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are hospitals, medical institutions, and retail pharmacies across China. The company also exports certain products to overseas markets, including Macau. Its products serve patients requiring treatment for immune deficiencies, bleeding disorders such as hemophilia, infectious diseases, and allergic conditions. The company participates in government procurement tenders and supplies a broad range of healthcare providers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China with plasma collection stations in 16 provinces and autonomous regions, totaling 102 stations, 80 of which are operational. It has production bases in Chengdu (Sichuan), Kunming (Yunnan), Lanzhou (Gansu), Shanghai, Wuhan, Guizhou, and Xi'an. The company also pursues international market expansion, focusing on product registration and export activities.
categories.supply_chain_position: Tiantan Biological operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the blood products supply chain. It controls plasma collection through its own single-donor plasma stations (upstream raw material sourcing), processes plasma into blood products (midstream manufacturing), and sells finished products to medical institutions and distributors (downstream sales).
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation-led growth with significant investment in R&D, focusing on new product development, process optimization, and quality management throughout the product lifecycle. Key R&D areas include recombinant coagulation factors, high-concentration immunoglobulins, and plasma protein comprehensive utilization. It adopts a centralized R&D model with decentralized registration to accelerate product commercialization and maintains a robust patent portfolio.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of blood products to hospitals, medical institutions, and distributors within China and abroad. The company participates in government procurement tenders and establishes contracts with regional designated distributors. Export sales are conducted via distributors under purchase agreements. Revenue is recognized upon product delivery and customer acceptance.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Tiantan Biological is a leading domestic player in China's blood products industry, with a significant market share and extensive production scale. It competes with other state-owned and private blood product manufacturers in China. The company leverages its scale, brand recognition, technological capabilities, and government backing to maintain a competitive advantage in the highly regulated and capital-intensive blood products sector.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 5.18 billion, a 21.57% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 1.11 billion, up 25.99%. Total assets reached about RMB 14.19 billion, with net assets of RMB 9.82 billion. The company has shown strong growth in revenue, profitability, and cash flow, supported by increased plasma collection volumes and product sales.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Tiantan Biological emphasizes product quality, safety, and innovation as its core value propositions. It maintains rigorous quality control systems, including virus nucleic acid screening and virus inactivation processes, ensuring high product safety standards. The company differentiates itself through a broad product portfolio, advanced recombinant product development, extensive plasma resource network, and strong brand reputation recognized by healthcare providers and regulators.
